heading: Define the acquisition help you need before comparing providers
body:
Short-term rental buyers may need help with different stages: market research, property sourcing, underwriting, offer coordination, inspections, financing, furnishing, or launch. List the stages where you need support before comparing acquisition services. A provider’s involvement in one stage does not establish responsibility for every part of the purchase.

Ask for the proposed deliverables, fees, decision rights, exclusions, and handoff points in writing. Identify which work belongs to licensed local professionals or independent specialists, and confirm who selects and pays them. A service description should explain responsibilities without replacing your own purchase judgment.

For a fictional out-of-state buyer, sourcing an appealing property is only the start. The buyer still needs address-specific use verification, insurance and financing information, condition review, and an operating plan. Record which party will obtain each item and what evidence the buyer will receive before committing.

Review the official company resources and proposed agreement alongside independent research. Selected property stories and projections can help frame questions; they do not establish the result of a future purchase. Use the consultation to define a clear acquisition process and the decisions that remain yours.
